intent: Implement IngestionController (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation inbound adapter: @RestController, POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets consuming application/json with a SINGLE JSON object body (type IngressPacketRequest, parameter annotated @Valid @RequestBody; WebFlux validation answers 400 at the boundary for constraint violations). ingest maps the request with request.toDomain(clock.instant()) (IllegalArgumentException -> ResponseStatusException 400), calls service.ingest(packet) and answers 202 Accepted with no body on success (on_success); when the service errors with IllegalStateException (stream overflow, on_overflow) answer 503 Service Unavailable via ResponseStatusException - never a silent drop and never 5xx for an invalid-but-bounded sample (those are tagged, not rejected). Delivery posture: at-least-once inbound; the dedup identity (deviceId, metric, tDevice) is owned by ReorderHistoryService so client retries never append duplicate revisions. Self-registered with @RestController; fully non-blocking.
